query: What does MediShield Life protect Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents against, regardless of their age or health condition?
reference_answer: MediShield Life protects Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents against large healthcare bills for life, regardless of their age or health condition.
answer: MediShield Life protects Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents against hospitalization costs, major organ transplant fees, and some outpatient treatments, regardless of age or pre-existing conditions. [Document 1]
